description:
Compute scheduled learning rates with linear ramp-up during early optimization steps to prevent initial gradient instability.

Linear warmup prevents early gradient updates from destabilizing randomly initialized weights before adaptive second-moment statistics calibrate.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\eta_t = \begin{cases} \eta_{\text{base}} \times \frac{t + 1}{T_{\text{warmup}}} & t < T_{\text{warmup}} \\ \eta_{\text{base}} & t \ge T_{\text{warmup}} \end{cases}
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Check if current step is within warmup duration
2. Scale base learning rate linearly with step progress
3. Maintain constant base learning rate once warmup completes

### Returns
Scalar float representing scheduled learning rate.
